name: Conduct Christian
overview: Scripture emphasizes that Christian conduct is rooted in a life that delights in and meditates on the law of the LORD, resulting in a blessed and fruitful existence like a well-watered tree (Psalms 1:1-3). The fear of the LORD is described as pure and enduring, providing true and righteous guidance that is more valuable than gold and sweeter than honey (Psalms 19:9-10). This reverent fear and adherence to God's commands bring great reward and serve as a warning to His servants, framing the believer's conduct as one that honors God through obedience and godly living (Psalms 19:11).
